'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***A [[Médecins Sans Frontières|Doctors Without Borders]] office in [[Pokrovsk, Ukraine|Pokrovsk]] is completely destroyed by a Russian missile strike. Five civilians are injured in the attack. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2024/apr/05/russia-ukraine-war-drones-attack-vladimir-putin-volodymyr-zelenskiy?page=with:block-66100a8c8f089151b4b243a6#block-66100a8c8f089151b4b243a6 (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Ukraine's [[Security Service of Ukraine|SBU]] claims to have destroyed six Russian military aircraft and heavily damaged eight others in a [[drone warfare|drone attack]] on [[Morozovsk (air base)|Morozovsk Air Base]] in [[Rostov Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-staged-major-attack-russias-morozovsk-military-air-base-kyiv-source-says-2024-04-05/ (Reuters)] [https://nos.nl/artikel/2515662-russische-gevechtsvliegtuigen-vernietigd-na-droneaanval-oekraine (NOS)]
**[[Zaporizhzhia strikes (2022–present)|Zaporizhzhia strikes]]
***At least three people are killed and at least 13 others are injured in a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[Double tap strike|double-tap]] [[missile]] strike in [[Zaporizhzhia]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/update-russian-attacks-on-zaporizhzhia-kill-3-injure-13/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-fires-five-missiles-ukraines-zaporizhzhia-three-people-killed-2024-04-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe]] launches a new currency, [[Zimbabwe Gold]], backed on [[gold]] reserves and foreign currencies amid depreciation of its current currency, the [[Zimbabwean dollar]]. [https://apnews.com/article/zimbabwe-new-currency-inflation-us-dollar-06a656260462d9651112e394e125c5e6 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 New Jersey earthquake]]
**A magnitude 4.8 [[earthquake]] strikes northwestern [[New Jersey]], causing tremors throughout the [[East Coast of the United States|East Coast]] of the [[United States]]. [https://abc6onyourside.com/news/nation-world/55-magnitude-earthquake-hits-new-york-city-area-north-plainfield-philadelphia-new-york-city-nyc-baltimore-washington-long-island (ABC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Ecuador–Mexico relations]]
**[[2024 raid on the Mexican embassy in Ecuador]]
***After local police arrest [[Vice President of Ecuador|former vice-president]] [[Jorge Glas]] at its embassy in Quito in violation of [https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Vienna_Convention_on_Diplomatic_Relations#Article_22 Article 22] of the [[Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations]], [[Mexico]] suspends diplomatic relations with [[Ecuador]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/apr/06/mexico-suspends-diplomatic-ties-with-ecuador-after-police-raid-embassy (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Armenia–European Union relations]]
**[[Armenia]] and the [[European Union]] agree on a landmark deal to support the [[Economy of Armenia|Armenian economy]] over the next four years following high-level talks in [[Brussels]]. The [[€]]270m support package is designed to help Armenia become less dependent on [[Russia]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/eu-launch-new-e270-million-plan-bring-armenia-fold-russia/ (Politico)]
*[[Belarus–NATO relations]]
**[[President of Belarus|President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] announces that [[Belarus]] will suspend its participation in the [[Treaty on Conventional Armed Forces in Europe]]. [https://apnews.com/article/belarus-to-suspend-conventional-forces-treaty-c79a8481e455f654f270268d4f7cdc03 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Argentina–Venezuela relations]]
**The [[Venezuelan government]] announces that it will give safe passage to [[Argentina]] to six aides of opposition leader [[María Corina Machado]] who are taking refuge in the Argentine embassy in [[Caracas]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/venezuela-allow-safe-passage-argentina-machado-aides-sources-2024-04-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Icelandic presidential election]]
**[[Prime Minister of Iceland|Prime Minister]] [[Katrín Jakobsdóttir]] resigns and announces that she is standing as a candidate for the presidential election on 1 June. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/icelands-prime-minister-resigns-will-run-president-2024-04-05/ (Reuters)]
